metadata.description: Claude Code plugins managed in atnook's dotfiles

plugins.name: prompt-rail
plugins.description: A rail of this session's prompts above the prompt input, in the style of beUI's Preview Rail: hover a tick to preview a prompt, click it to jump there.

plugins.name: sitrep
plugins.description: A situation report above the prompt input, colored like an andon: where the work stands, what is unconfirmed, the decision that waits on you and the next step, each a key away from the prompt box.
